claim: Same-held-material repetition works with retained personal evidence; autonomous intake remains mixed and below balance; delayed-toxicity exposure increases in the controlled fixture.

limitations: Controlled opportunity assay, not autonomous foraging or a sustainability estimate.
Initial hunger is an explicit matched body fixture. Each acquisition and each first taste is externally scheduled by this developer harness; no knowledge or food is injected.

When the learner proposes another operation, this assay allows idle time rather than executing it. This favors both arms and isolates sampling opportunity; full regional trials measure actual competing actions.
All swallowing, costs, digestion, finite material transfer and environment clocks remain authoritative. New pieces earn their own feedback.
The three-piece assay measures whole acquisition-to-swallow cycles from one reachable finite source, without travel, and is not indefinite carrying capacity.
Controlled safety opportunity assay, not autonomous hunting, foraging, survival or clinical physiology.

Initial fixture converts one existing rabbit to a carcass with four authoritative power-4 strike API calls before the measurement opening. No food or body energy is added. The carcass is explicitly aged to its catalog spoil threshold of 72 game hours and marked spoiled; world elapsed remains zero, so historical aging is a fixture rather than simulated history.

Initial hunger of 12 game hours is an explicit matched body fixture. One acquisition and the first two tastes are externally scheduled through authoritative action APIs; both real distinct sustained effects must arrive before policy comparison.

After the second sustained outcome, only learner-selected samples of that original held piece are executed, with ordinary costs and 0.65-second decision intervals. Other proposed actions are recorded and deferred. This isolates delayed exposure and is not a free-running policy test.
Full environment, ecology and body clocks advance at 1/60 s. Existing spoiled material decay remains active. No weather, physiology, supply, action-cost or rest parameters are changed.

Gross toxic harm is summed from actual per-ingestion harm; the final removal tick uses the unchanged digestion formula to recover harm omitted when an entry is removed. Net health can also reflect weather, hydration and recovery.

After the last admitted sample, the assay continues until every sampled ingestion has left the gut. This does not establish long-horizon memory permanence or prevention of all later generic exploration.

verification.resourceCaveat: Two cohort processes ran concurrently, initially sharing CPU with tests and native checks. Sampled process RSS and container timings are not laptop capacity or latency measurements.

limitations: Same physical material evidence does not generalize to other pieces, source appearances or species.
Two nourishing outcomes do not prove safety: the controlled spoiled-flesh assay increases pre-discomfort exposure.
The finite opportunity assay schedules initial acquisition/tastes and defers other choices; it is not autonomous foraging.
Ordinary twelve-hour results are mixed and below energy balance; no sustained survival, seasonal or learned migration claim.
No physical laptop or live Ollama trial.
